topic: Describe the First Snow(描写初雪)
genre: 记叙 / 描写文(describe a winter scene and your feelings)
source: 外研社新标准选择性必修第三册 Unit 6 First Snow:写一篇约100词的短文,描写初雪的景象与感受,自然用上非谓语动词作定语/状语/补语。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华。上周你的城市迎来了今年的第一场雪。请用英语写一篇约100词的短文,描写初雪的景象和你的感受,内容包括:① 你早上醒来看到的雪景;② 你和家人或朋友做的一件事;③ 初雪带给你的感受。注意:适当使用非谓语动词作定语、状语或补语(如 the falling snow / Looking out of the window, I … / I saw the children playing)。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Last week your city had its first snow of the year. Write a short passage of about 100 words describing the first snow and your feelings, including: 1) the snowy scene you saw when you woke up; 2) one thing you did with your family or friends; 3) how the first snow made you feel. Try to use non-finite verbs as attributive, adverbial or complement (e.g. the falling snow / Looking out of the window, I … / I saw the children playing).
points: 描写雪景(定语非谓语:the falling snow / the snow-covered roofs)
用分词状语开头(Looking out of the window, I saw …)
用补语结构(I saw the children playing / found the garden covered)
表达真实感受 + 句子地道连贯、代词指代清楚
model_essay: Last Wednesday I woke up to find the whole world turned white. Looking out of the window, I saw soft snow falling quietly past the glass. The garden, the roofs and the old plum tree were all covered in a thick white blanket. Excited by the magical scene, my sister and I quickly got dressed and rushed outside. We rolled the fresh snow into a big ball and built a cheerful snowman, laughing until our cheeks turned red. Standing in the falling snow, I felt as happy and free as a little child. The first snow had truly turned an ordinary morning into something magical.
model_translation: 上周三我醒来,发现整个世界都变白了。望向窗外,我看见柔软的雪静静地落过玻璃。花园、屋顶和那棵老李树都盖上了厚厚的白毯。被这神奇的景象激动着,我和妹妹很快穿好衣服冲了出去。我们把新雪滚成一个大球,堆了一个快乐的雪人,笑得脸都红了。站在纷飞的雪中,我感到像个孩子一样快乐而自由。初雪真的把一个平凡的早晨变成了奇妙的时光。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:醒来所见雪景 / 与家人朋友做的一件事 / 初雪带来的感受
围绕初雪展开、按时间顺序、句句相关、代词指代清楚、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、非谓语作定语/状语/补语运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 开头状语 Looking out of the window, I saw …
定语 the falling snow / the snow-covered roofs
补语 I saw the children playing / found the garden covered
感受句 Standing in the falling snow, I felt …
key_expressions: Looking out of the window, I saw soft snow falling quietly past the glass.
The garden and roofs were all covered in a thick white blanket.
Excited by the magical scene, my sister and I rushed outside.
Standing in the falling snow, I felt as happy as a little child.

high_sentences: Looking out of the window, I saw soft snow falling quietly past the glass.
The roofs and trees were all covered in a thick white blanket.
Excited by the magical scene, my sister and I rushed straight outside.
Standing in the falling snow, I felt as happy as a little child.

error_pairs.wrong: Look out of the window, I saw the snow.
error_pairs.correct: Looking out of the window, I saw the snow.
error_pairs.note: 主句主语 I 与 look 是主动关系,状语用现在分词 Looking。

error_pairs.wrong: The garden was cover with snow.
error_pairs.correct: The garden was covered with snow.
error_pairs.note: garden 被雪覆盖,被动用过去分词 covered。

error_pairs.wrong: I saw the children played in the snow.
error_pairs.correct: I saw the children playing in the snow.
error_pairs.note: see sb doing:动作正在进行用现在分词 playing,不用过去式。

paragraph_template:
【初雪描写结构】
第1句 醒来所见:I woke up to find … / Looking out of the window, I saw …
第2-3句 雪景(定语非谓语):the falling snow / the snow-covered roofs / trees bending under the snow
第4-5句 做的事(补语结构):I saw … playing / we built a snowman
第6句 感受:Standing in the falling snow, I felt …
